JeCCDO Citizens Engagement Program - Phase II

description.narrative: Outcome 1: Targeted women have improved their income and increasingly claim their rights and contribute to peace Output 1.1: Women organized/strengthened in SHGs and engaged in profitable individual IGAs Output 1.2: CLAs or WPF are engaged in advocacy, SA and peace building Outcome 2: Government partners and Iddir-led CBOs have increased capacity and a common platform for jointly improving basic services and building peace Output 2.1. Key government partners capacitated on SA and peace building tools Output 2.2. Iddir-led CBOs are empowered to engage in IGA, SA, womens empowerment, and peacebuilding Output 2.3. Gender-balanced SACs established/revitalized Outcome 3: Citizens know their rights and ensure that local development initiatives respond to their priority needs. Output 3.1: Citizens are aware of service standards and service quality and priority needs are assessed Output 3.2: Citizens and service providers agree on priority development needs and these are integrated into woreda plans and budgets Output 3.3: Citizen priorities are implemented and jointly monitored
Projektet syftar till att stärka lokalsamhällen så att de kan hålla lokala myndigheter ansvariga för att förbättra tjänster, främja fred och jämställdhet i Etiopien.
The Project are Empowering Communities to hold local governments accountable for improving services, fostering peace, and promoting gender equality in Ethiopia.
